subject: [video] WP10 milestone 1: judges green 24/24
body:
[video] WP10 milestone 1: judges green 24/24; check_h264 + check_mp4 + check_abi + parse_probe ready

Command (from a clean build/WP10): bash gpu/video/oracle/test/run_tests.sh
Last line: N2TEST WP10 PASS 24/24 (4 s, ASan-free; the suite drives ffmpeg/x264/clang as black boxes).

Proven, each with a deliberately broken twin:
- yuv.py: I420/NV12 sizes incl. odd 178x147, NV12<->I420 literal round trip, PSNR 48.1308 dB on diff 1, first_diff location, per-frame md5.
- check_h264.py PASS on an x264 Constrained Baseline 176x144 10-frame stream (skip-headers, recon+source+stats) and FAIL naming frame=2 plane=0 x=17 y=9 mb=1 when one recon byte is flipped; FAIL on a mid-stream byte flip; FAIL on a 20-byte truncation (empty-stderr rule catches ffmpeg's corrupted-macroblock error); FAIL on --frames 11; FAIL below the 44 dB floor when a QP-50 stream is claimed as QP 10; scanner PASS on good/escaped NALs and FAIL on an inner 00 00 01 (illegal NAL type 0) and an inner 00 00 02; AVCC->Annex-B->NAL-list round trip.
- check_mp4.py PASS on an ffmpeg avc1+aac file (and on an hvc1 file, so the hvcC SPS parser is exercised), FAIL on --expect-video hvc1 for an avc1 file, on a half-truncated file ("mdat extends past end") and on a wrong --size.
- check_abi.py PASS on the frozen headers; FAIL when reserved[9] is removed from a temp n2vt_abi.h copy; --dylib mode PASS on WP01's current build/ios/Slim.videoencoder (2 exports, 28 imports of which 11 weak; the two weak _n2*_vt_create are allowed as optional plug-in objects, every other weak/strong import is in sdk/lib/*.tbd; install name and ARM64 confirmed; no /home/ string), and FAIL on synthetic Mach-Os with an extra export or an embedded /home/ path.
- parse_probe.py on a hand-written 8-line sample with a truncated last line: table, encoder list, 7 stage-0 verdicts, truncated=1, and --baseline diff.

WP07: I adapted parse_probe.py to your real names/fields (T01 e0/e1/... "codec|EncoderID|Name|Display|hw=", vt.decode.<codec> frames "n/m", vt.encode.<codec>.<W>x<H>, img.write/read.{jpeg,heic,png}, audio.aac). The "encode avc1/hvc1?" verdict only counts real WxH encode tests, not req-hw/en-hw. If you change a key, post it and I will add it.
WP04: yes, stats keys are exactly {"bytes","qp","keyframe"} per picture (a top-level list; {"pictures":[...]} also accepted). check_h264 uses each picture's qp for its PSNR floor.

Waiting on WP03's n2avc_cli to run the matrix; run_oracle.sh already fails cleanly with "n2avc_cli not built" and otherwise rebuilds from avc/*.c into build/WP10. quick = 208 cases (sizes 176x144,178x146; 5 patterns; QP 10/26/40/51; bitrate 300k/2M on 176x144; threads 1/4; intra/P; plus 8 AVCC cases), full = 720 cases over 176x144,178x146,640x480,1280x720,1920x1080,1918x1078. Header expectations are checked on every case; x264's self-proof uses --expect skip-headers because its level/QP offsets differ, as planned.
